# salla-mcp

[![CI](https://github.com/theYahia/salla-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/theYahia/salla-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

MCP server for the [Salla](https://salla.sa) e-commerce platform (Saudi Arabia). Manage
products, categories, brands, orders, customers, coupons, branches, and store settings
through the Salla Admin API v2 — with OAuth 2.0, automatic token refresh, and rate-limit
aware retries.

## Tools (22)

### Products

| Tool                     | Description                                    |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `list_products`          | List products (pagination + status filter)     |
| `get_product`            | Get a product by ID                            |
| `get_product_by_sku`     | Get a product by SKU                           |
| `create_product`         | Create a new product                           |
| `update_product`         | Update an existing product                     |
| `delete_product`         | Delete a product                               |
| `bulk_update_quantities` | Bulk-update stock by product/variant ID or SKU |

### Categories & brands

| Tool              | Description                               |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `list_categories` | List categories (keyword + status filter) |
| `get_category`    | Get a category by ID                      |
| `create_category` | Create a category                         |
| `list_brands`     | List brands                               |

### Orders

| Tool                  | Description                              |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `list_orders`         | List orders (pagination + status filter) |
| `get_order`           | Get an order by ID                       |
| `update_order_status` | Update an order's fulfillment status     |
| `list_order_statuses` | List valid order statuses for the store  |
| `get_order_histories` | Get an order's status-change timeline    |

### Customers, store & operations

| Tool                   | Description                        |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `list_customers`       | List customers                     |
| `get_customer`         | Get a customer by ID               |
| `get_store_info`       | Get store information and settings |
| `list_coupons`         | List discount coupons              |
| `list_abandoned_carts` | List abandoned carts               |
| `list_branches`        | List store branches                |

## Quick Start

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "salla": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@theyahia/salla-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "SALLA_ACCESS_TOKEN": "<YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Authentication

Salla uses OAuth 2.0. You can run this server in one of two ways.

### Option 1 — Static access token (simplest)

Set `SALLA_ACCESS_TOKEN`. **Salla access tokens expire after 14 days**, after which calls
fail with `401` and you must supply a new token. Good for quick local use; for anything
long-running, use auto-refresh below.

### Option 2 — Auto-refresh (recommended for long-running use)

Provide your app's OAuth credentials and a refresh token, and the server refreshes the
access token automatically — proactively before expiry and reactively on a `401`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "salla": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@theyahia/salla-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "SALLA_CLIENT_ID": "<CLIENT_ID>",
        "SALLA_CLIENT_SECRET": "<CLIENT_SECRET>",
        "SALLA_REFRESH_TOKEN": "<REFRESH_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Salla refresh tokens are **single-use and rotate** on every refresh (and themselves expire
after ~1 month). To survive restarts, the server persists the latest tokens to a token
store file (`SALLA_TOKEN_STORE`, default `~/.salla-mcp/token.json`) and reloads them on
start. Concurrent refreshes are collapsed into one request, which Salla requires.

### Where credentials come from

Create an app in the [Salla Partners portal](https://salla.partners) and install it on a
store. In **Easy Mode**, Salla delivers the access token to your app's configured webhook
on the `app.store.authorize` event. In **Custom Mode**, you take the `Client ID` /
`Client Secret` from the app's keys and run the standard authorization-code exchange
against `https://accounts.salla.sa/oauth2/token`. See the
[Salla authorization docs](https://docs.salla.dev/doc-421118).

## Environment Variables

| Variable              | Required                | Default                                  | Description                          |
| --------------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `SALLA_ACCESS_TOKEN`  | One of these two setups | –                                        | OAuth 2.0 access token               |
| `SALLA_CLIENT_ID`     | For auto-refresh        | –                                        | OAuth app client ID                  |
| `SALLA_CLIENT_SECRET` | For auto-refresh        | –                                        | OAuth app client secret              |
| `SALLA_REFRESH_TOKEN` | For auto-refresh        | –                                        | OAuth refresh token (rotated on use) |
| `SALLA_TOKEN_STORE`   | No                      | `~/.salla-mcp/token.json`                | Where rotated tokens are persisted   |
| `SALLA_BASE_URL`      | No                      | `https://api.salla.dev/admin/v2`         | API base URL                         |
| `SALLA_TIMEOUT_MS`    | No                      | `15000`                                  | Per-request timeout                  |
| `SALLA_MAX_RETRIES`   | No                      | `3`                                      | Retries for `429`/`5xx` responses    |
| `SALLA_TOKEN_URL`     | No                      | `https://accounts.salla.sa/oauth2/token` | OAuth token endpoint                 |

## Rate Limits

Salla enforces per-plan limits over a 1-minute window (Plus 120, Pro 360, Special 720
requests/min). On `429` the server honors the `Retry-After` header and retries with
exponential backoff; transient `5xx` responses are retried too, up to `SALLA_MAX_RETRIES`.

## Demo Prompts

- "List all products in my Salla store"
- "Create a new product called 'Premium Dates' for 150 SAR"
- "What order statuses can I set, and move order 1001 to completed"
- "Sync stock: set SKU ABC-1 to 40 units"
- "Show me the abandoned carts from this week"

## Troubleshooting

- **`Salla authentication is not configured`** — set `SALLA_ACCESS_TOKEN`, or the three
  `SALLA_CLIENT_ID` / `SALLA_CLIENT_SECRET` / `SALLA_REFRESH_TOKEN` variables.
- **`Salla HTTP 401`** with a static token — the token has expired (14-day lifetime);
  generate a new one or switch to auto-refresh.
- **Repeated `401` after refresh** — your refresh token may have been consumed elsewhere
  (they are single-use). Delete the token store file and re-supply a fresh refresh token.
- **`Salla HTTP 429`** — you hit the plan rate limit; the server already retries, but
  sustained high volume needs a higher Salla plan.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # run the server with tsx (stdio)
npm test             # vitest
npm run lint         # eslint
npm run typecheck    # tsc --noEmit
npm run build        # emit dist/
```
